title: Bank Lending And Loan Administration
modules: Asset And Liability Management In Banks
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the type of loan guaranteed by collateral such as a property, equipment or inventory of products."
Secured loans refer to the type of loan guaranteed by collateral such as a property, equipment or inventory of products.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the risk arising from the use of short term liabilities to finance long term assets."
Liquidity risk refers to the risk arising from the use of short term liabilities to finance long term assets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to relating the total value of the current assets to the total of the current Liabilities."
The current ratio refers to relating the total value of the current assets to the total of the current Liabilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a short-term loan which is normally obtained by a firm to finance its day-to-day operations."
The working capital loan is a short-term loan which is normally obtained by a firm to finance its day-to-day operations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the net profits from the operations of the business, indicative of total revenue less all expenses, and combined with non-cash expenses such as the amount of depreciation of capital assets."

The net cash inflows is the net profits from the operations of the business, indicative of total revenue less all expenses, and combined with non-cash expenses such as the amount of depreciation of capital assets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined cash inflows from the operations of the firm."
The consideration is defined cash inflows from the operations of the firm.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as his or her authority in lending, and any loan request in excess of such lending authority will have to be communicated to the head office for advice."
The limit is regarded as his or her authority in lending, and any loan request in excess of such lending authority will have to be communicated to the head office for advice.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for determining whether the customer's business will be generating sufficient amount of cash inflows for the regular repayment of the loan."
Credit Analysis The credit analysis is used for determining whether the customer's business will be generating sufficient amount of cash inflows for the regular repayment of the loan.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the plan that is designed to take care of accumulated payments."
The repayment plan is the plan that is designed to take care of accumulated payments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the property that is pledged by a loan beneficiary towards securing the facility."
Collateral security is the property that is pledged by a loan beneficiary towards securing the facility.
